theorems.statement: For a fixed Newton multiplicity r and scale theta, source Taylor coefficient states are equivalent for the complete residual Newton observer exactly when every residual coordinate (rho,k), rho=sigma theta^(k-r), has the same coefficient sum.  The kernel is generated by within-fiber provenance transfers, Q^I/ker(Pi) is canonically Q^C, and this is the coarsest exact quotient preserving the complete residual jet and all deterministic future operations that factor through it.

negative_boundaries.statement: Edge-only or weaker observers can admit strictly coarser quotients.
Fiber aggregation forgets source labels and internal splitting.
Distinct residual scales remain observable even at equal Taylor degree.
Distinct Taylor degrees remain observable even at equal residual scale.
Cancellation after characteristic/Taylor compression does not create signed branch semantics.
The T6 future-observation principle is reused, but its finite deterministic endomap implementation does not compute this linear quotient.
